info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 1 - Complete Requests
info.description: Prepared from the assignment project routes and existing test scenarios. This file contains request definitions and expected-status assertions, not recorded test results. Existing screenshots remain the evidence of previous runs. Import without rerunning or retaking screenshots. For future use, log in A/B to populate blank token variables; supply existing employee IDs or intentionally create setup records. Save tokens only locally and clear them before export. Signup/login share 10 requests per IP per 15 minutes: run authentication tests in separate windows or wait for Retry-After. Rate-limit and expired-token checks require manual setup. Do not run all folders as an unattended sequence. Deletion is restricted to a separately created disposable record.

request.description: Expected HTTP 200. Inspect response headers for Helmet protections.

item.name: 08 Rate limit manual test - run last

request.description: Expected HTTP 429. Send manually until the shared 10 requests per 15 minutes limit is exceeded. Before that, 401 is expected and this 429 assertion will fail. Inspect Retry-After and RateLimit headers. Do not run the whole collection blindly; authentication validation tests also consume this limit.
